intro.speaker: STUDENT
intro.text:
I arrived before everyone else today.
For once, I will not be late for Discrete Mathematics.

intro.speaker: STUDENT
intro.text:
Why is the classroom empty?
The corridor is silent too. Something feels wrong.

intro.speaker: STUDENT
intro.text:
What?! The lights went out! There is someone at the door.
Those are not ordinary students. An outbreak has started.

intro.speaker: Duman Adilet
intro.text:
Stay calm. I will guard the doorway so none of them get in.
Check the computer; it has your first clue.

intro.speaker: Duman Adilet
intro.text:
The password is decimal 10 converted to binary.
Enter all four digits. Take your phone and your bag afterward.

intro.speaker: STUDENT
intro.text:
Understood, Duman Adilet. You watch the door.
I will check the computer and find a way to help everyone.

quest.speaker: COMPUTER / FIRST OBJECTIVE
quest.text:
Collect your phone and personal belongings from locker 08.
It is at the far-right end of the block-3 corridor.
The locker PIN is a four-digit number you know well.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
If you are watching this, the outbreak has started.
I prepared a neutralizer, but kept the ingredients apart for safety.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
There are THREE ingredients. The CULTURE BASE is in the
block-3 computer lab, upstairs from room 361. Read its protocol.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
Take the access card from this lectern. It only opens the
block-3 passage. Recover the culture base before you leave.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
In block 2, repair four backup circuits in the lower power room.
Then recover the STABILIZER in the upper-right filter lab.
The valve settings are written beside the equipment.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
In block 1, the CATALYST is locked in the lower archive lab.
Calibrate its scanner. Kamila Batkuldinova is waiting in room 354.

video.speaker: DR. OMAR / BIOLOGIST / RECORDING
video.text:
In 354, blend STABILIZER, then BASE, then CATALYST.
Connect the cartridge, select ALL BLOCKS and start ventilation.
Save the plan on your phone. Everyone can still be cured.

messenger.name: NURALI
messages: Bro, where are you? Something terrible is happening in C1.3...
The lights are flickering. Someone is scratching at the door. This is not a joke.
Did you hear those screams? I am seriously scared.
messenger.reply: Yes! I noticed it too. What is happening here?
messenger.followup: I have no idea. Just be careful. I will keep the door locked.
